title: Billion dollar failures, and billion dollar success | Tom Conrad (Quibi, Pandora, Pets.com, Snap, Zero)
summary: Tom Conrad is the CEO of Zero and on the board of Sonos. He began his career in engineering at Apple, where he helped build key features that remain in iOS today. Tom was previously the VP of Product at Snap and the chief technology officer of Pandora. He also held leadership positions at notable tech flops Pets.com and Quibi, giving him a unique perspective not only on what it takes to build a successful company but also on lessons from failure. In today’s conversation, we discuss: • Lessons learned from the infamous failures of Pets.com and Quibi • Lessons learned from the successes of Apple, Pandora, and Snap • Advice on choosing where to work • Understanding the math formula of a business • How to avoid burnout • Why Tom says not everyone needs to be a founder • What he’s building now — Brought to you by Coda —Meet the evolution of
